info.title: Vote Tracker Integration API
info.description:
Public API for integration owners: read votes, create and manage giveaways, and
fulfill shop purchases. Authenticate with an API key from the
[dashboard](https://votetracker.bot/dashboard/api) as `Authorization: Bearer vtk_live_...`.

## Guides

- [Webhook Forwarding Guide](/docs/forwarding) covers event payloads, signatures, retries and delivery logs.
- [Giveaways API Guide](/docs/giveaways) covers automated giveaways, reward payloads and rerolls.
- [Shop Economy Guide](/docs/economy) covers developer shop items, purchase webhooks and the fulfillment contract.

## Official SDKs

- TypeScript / JavaScript: [`@votetracker/sdk`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@votetracker/sdk) covers the full API and webhook forwarding ([source](https://github.com/votetracker-bot/sdks)).

ComponentMessage.description: Discord announcement message built from components.

role_id.description: Role the multiplier applies to, as a string id.

multiplier_percent.description: Entry multiplier in percent, 100 means unchanged, 200 doubles the entries.

starts_at.description: When entries start counting. ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (e.g. 2026-02-25T22:10:00Z).

ends_at.description: When the giveaway ends and winners are drawn. ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (e.g. 2026-02-25T22:10:00Z).

winner_count.description: How many winners to draw, 1 to 100.

prize_text.description: Prize shown in announcements and the dashboard.

base_entries_per_vote.description: Entries granted per vote, 1 to 100. Default 1.

required_role_ids.description: Role ids a voter must have to enter, as strings. Premium.

required_role_match_mode.description: Whether ANY or ALL of the required roles must be present. Default ANY.

excluded_role_ids.description: Role ids that disqualify a voter, as strings. Premium.

announcement_channel_id.description: Channel id for the start and winner announcements, as a string. No announcements without it.

message.description: Custom start announcement. Without it the bot posts its default message.

completed_message.description: Custom winner announcement. Without it the bot posts its default message.

sender_name.description: Custom sender name for the announcement webhook. Premium branding.

sender_avatar_url.description: Custom sender avatar URL for the announcement webhook. Premium branding.

repeating.description: Repeat automatically after each draw with the same duration. Premium.

external_reward.description: Opaque reward payload echoed in winner webhooks, max 2048 bytes. JSON object or array, the schema is yours. Premium.

require_guild_membership.description: Voters must be members of the server to enter. Default true.

prize_image_url.description: Https image URL shown in the default announcement, max 512 characters.

JsonElement.description: Opaque JSON value, object or array.

prize_text.description: Prize shown in announcements and the dashboard.

base_entries_per_vote.description: Entries granted per vote. Absent when 1.

repeating.description: Whether the giveaway repeats after each draw. Absent when false.

require_guild_membership.description: Whether voters must be members of the server to enter. Absent when false.

external_reward.description: Owner-defined reward payload, echoed verbatim. Null when not configured.

prize_image_url.description: Https image URL shown in the default announcement.

announcement_error.description: Set when the last announcement attempt failed, cleared on success.

winners.description: Winner list, absent until winners are drawn.

user_platform_id.description: Winner's user id on the voting platform.

rank.description: Winner rank, 1 is the top winner.

entries_at_draw.description: Entries the winner had at draw time.

discord_id.description: Optional Discord snowflake for actions on Discord. Equals user_platform_id for BOT/SERVER projects. Differs for GAME projects (the winner's linked Discord account) and is null when the voter never linked one.

rerolled.description: True when this winner replaced a previous one through a reroll. Absent when false.

error_code.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Clients should tolerate unknown values.

repeating.description: Enable or disable the repeating schedule.

reason.description: Free-text note for your own support trail. Logged, never stored on the purchase.

failure_reason.description: Why the purchase failed or was refunded. Null while the purchase is still good.

fulfill_deadline_at.description: When an unacked developer claim refunds itself. Null for every other kind. ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (e.g. 2026-02-25T22:10:00Z).

reason.description: Why the reroll happened. Kept in the audit trail, never shown in the Discord channel.

cancel_reason.description: Required while the giveaway is active.

guild_id.description: Discord server id as a string. The bot must be in it and the integration's linked owner needs Manage Server there.

starts_at.description: When entries start counting. ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (e.g. 2026-02-25T22:10:00Z).

ends_at.description: When the giveaway ends and winners are drawn. ISO-8601 UTC timestamp (e.g. 2026-02-25T22:10:00Z).

excluded_role_ids.description: Role ids that disqualify a voter, as strings. Premium.

sender_name.description: Custom sender name for the announcement webhook. Premium branding.

sender_avatar_url.description: Custom sender avatar URL for the announcement webhook. Premium branding.

repeating.description: Repeat automatically after each draw with the same duration. Premium.

external_reward.description: Opaque reward payload echoed in winner webhooks, max 2048 bytes. JSON object or array, the schema is yours. Premium.

require_guild_membership.description: Voters must be members of the server to enter. Default true.

prize_image_url.description: Https image URL shown in the default announcement, max 512 characters.

activate.description: Activate immediately instead of leaving the giveaway as a draft.
